items: Regenerative Medicine (dobara banane wali tib): stem cells kharab tissues aur organs ki marammat kar sakte hain ya un ki jagah naye bana sakte hain. Is liye inhen spinal cord (haram maghz) ki chot, type 1 diabetes, Parkinson's disease aur dil ki beemari ke ilaj mein istemal kiya jata hai.

Drug Testing and Development (dawaon ki jaanch aur tayyari): stem cells ko khaas qisam ke cells mein badal kar researchers insani beemariyon ke models bana sakte hain. Is se dawaon ke asar ki zyada durust jaanch hoti hai aur janwaron par tajurbon ki zaroorat kam hoti hai.

Personalized Medicine (har mareez ke liye alag ilaj): stem cells mareez ke apne cells se banaye ja sakte hain, is liye ilaj mein immune rejection (jism ka naye cells ko rad karna) ka khatra kam hota hai. Yeh tareeqa zyada moassar aur mehfooz ilaj de sakta hai.
